verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents building automations (flows), and Composer says it builds marketing 'for your review'. Nothing in the evidence shows version history, a review workflow for automation changes, or rollback to a prior flow version. Composer's review of AI-drafted marketing is an adjacent feature, not automation versioning or rollback, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
